item.title: Stellwerk 0.24.0
item.description:
Minor Changes

  • #42 `a3ea1f1` Thanks @fabifink! - Operator: off by default, with an on/off switch at the top of Settings → Operator on the Mac. Its model, to-do and summary settings show once it's on. While off, no app shows the Operator, no summaries are written and new to-dos stay in the list; turning it on or off shows or hides it on the Mac, iPhone, iPad and Android right away.

    • Patch Changes

  • #40 `5709ef2` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Stellwerk for Mac: Usage tab → "Use the account with the most of its week left". New turns run on the Claude account that has used the least of its weekly limit; Stellwerk switches once another is 5 points lower (asking it first with a one-word Haiku turn, so the number is fresh) and, when limits run out, to the account with the most left.
  • #37 `8ff9550` Thanks @fabifink! - Mac: links in replies are blue, like on the iPhone and Android. They had the text colour before.
  • #40 `5709ef2` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Stellwerk for Mac: when the window can't reach the Mac's own host, it says why (busy, not listening, connection broke off) instead of asking about Tailscale. The API server starts again by itself if it stops. The host log (Copy diagnostics) now notes when the window loses and regains its host, and when the host stalls because every thread waits for a tool, with the tools running then.
  • #38 `eace0e9` Thanks @fabifink! - A message sent to a new workspace before its folder is there waits in the chat's queue and goes out once it is, instead of failing with "The workspace's folder isn't there (yet)". Creating the folder fetches the default branch first, which can take a while (up to two minutes when GitHub is slow).

item.title: Stellwerk 0.23.1
item.description:
Patch Changes

  • #29 `c6da6e4` Thanks @fabifink! - Code blocks in chat replies: on the Mac the gray box now sits around the whole block (the first line no longer hangs above it, a block at the start of a reply keeps its top padding), long lines wrap between words instead of mid-word (a path or token wider than the box still breaks where it must), text selected in a code block is highlighted again instead of hidden under the box, the selection no longer fills the space between blocks, and every code block has a copy button in its corner, always visible as on the phones, that copies the code exactly as written. Dragging selected text out of a reply carries the same plain text as Copy. iPhone and iPad: a code block's copy button no longer adds a trailing line break, as on Android. Phones keep scrolling long code lines sideways.
  • #36 `59e9385` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Continue after a merge names the new branch after the merged one with `-v2` (`-v3` and on when that's taken, or when the merged branch was a `-v2` already), as Conductor does, instead of after the workspace's folder (a city name), which the automatic branch rename then never replaced. iPhone, iPad, Android and the Mac alike: the Mac names the branch.
  • #35 `dba1739` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Your GitHub picture in the host switcher no longer turns into an initial for good: the apps ask the Mac again when the first ask failed (on the Mac, its own host still starting), the Mac asks GitHub again when `gh` couldn't answer at launch, and the iPhone, iPad and Mac apps load GitHub pictures again after a failed download instead of keeping the initial. Android already did the last part.
  • #35 `dba1739` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Mac: Claude runs only on the account marked Active. Picking another account (or Stellwerk switching at the limits) moves the running Claude chats over too: idle ones right away, working ones after their turn; before, a chat's process stayed on the old account until you wrote in it again, and what it did on its own meanwhile (a background task finishing) still counted there. Everything else Stellwerk starts that can call Claude (branch names, the Operator's line per chat, the new-topic check, git and Entire's hooks on Push and Pull) now runs on the active account too instead of Claude Code's own login. A switch at the limits goes on to the next account in the list instead of always back to the first one with room.
  • #36 `59e9385` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Mac: the host keeps a log on disk (`~/Library/Logs/Stellwerk/host.log`), so a problem can be followed afterwards, also across restarts. Settings → Advanced → Activity shows its last 300 lines instead of 8, with "Show log in Finder" and "Copy diagnostics", which puts the versions, the Claude accounts with their limits, which chat runs on which account and the log's last lines on the clipboard, without tokens or chat contents. The log now also says on which Claude account each chat starts, when the account changes and why (picked, or the limits ran out), when an account's limits run out or come back, which chats move to another account or model, and each helper call, Push, Pull and Entire hook with the account it ran on.
  • #33 `ba3debf` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Mac: added Claude accounts (tokens from `claude setup-token`) show their session and week in the Usage tab: Refresh asks them with a one-word Haiku turn, since /usage only shows the cost for such tokens. Tokens pasted with line breaks from Terminal work again.
  • #33 `ba3debf` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Mac: the Usage tab shows each Claude account's extra usage this month (spent and the monthly cap, with a bar), as Claude Code's /usage reports it.
  • #33 `ba3debf` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Mac: a new workspace's message box takes the focus even when its chat comes up a moment later.
  • #33 `ba3debf` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Mac: text selected in a reply stays selected when you let go of the mouse, so it can be copied. Replies with characters the font lacks (→, ✅), code blocks or quotes lost the selection right away.
  • #33 `ba3debf` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Mac: a tool call's file chip (Read, Edit, Write) opens the file in a tab next to the chats, like the chips in your messages: images as images, other files with their content, an edited file with its diff.
  • #33 `ba3debf` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Mac: the tab picked at the bottom of the right panel (Setup, Run, Usage) stays when you switch workspaces and after a restart.
  • #33 `ba3debf` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Mac: sending a message with videos no longer fails with "the file is empty": clearing the message box deleted the videos' copies before they were uploaded.
  • #28 `7ce1a51` Thanks @fabifink! - Chats and the Operator come back by themselves after Stellwerk on the Mac restarted or the connection broke for a moment. A chat that failed to load tried again only after half a minute while the live updates were still connected, so it stayed empty with "Stellwerk isn't running on the Mac" although the Mac was back; now it tries again after 1, 2, 4 and 8 seconds, then every 10. The Operator asked for its chat only once when its screen opened, so one failed request left it without its chat bar until the screen was opened again; now it keeps asking until the Mac answers. Mac, iPhone, iPad and Android alike.
  • #35 `dba1739` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Mac: Review sits at the right end of the Changes/Checks bar, with an eye, instead of in the PR button's menu.
  • #34 `8f5be68` Thanks @GarreltMock! - iPhone, iPad and Android: a project's team chats open from a people button next to its "+", as on the Mac, instead of the Team chats block under it. Every app: a workspace opens on the chat you last had open there (kept across launches) instead of the newest tab, unless another chat has new replies and that one hasn't; a notification still opens its own chat. Mac Usage tab: each Claude account in a card of its own with Claude's mark, "Use" at the top right, and its own Refresh and last update. Mac "Install from source": a finished build has ✕ next to "Install now" to discard it and build something else.
  • #32 `0cdc848` Thanks @fabifink! - A ToolSearch call in a chat no longer shows as an empty "grep for ''": it reads "Load tools" with the tools it loads ("select:Read,Edit" → "Read, Edit"), or "Search tools" with what it searched for. On the Mac, iPhone, iPad and Android.
  • #28 `7ce1a51` Thanks @fabifink! - When an app and the Mac it's connected to no longer fit together, the app says which one to update ("Update Stellwerk on this device: Mac mini runs Stellwerk 0.30.0, which needs a newer app than 0.22.1.", or "Update Stellwerk on Mac mini") in the list of workspaces, instead of failing quietly or showing "The data couldn't be read". The Mac tells the apps which wire format it speaks (`api`, `minAppAPI` in `/api/health`), and the apps send theirs (`X-Stellwerk-API`, `X-Stellwerk-Version`); a Mac that needs a newer app answers 426 with that message, which older apps show too. Nothing changes for today's apps and Macs: every version still works with every other. Mac, iPhone, iPad and Android alike.

item.title: Stellwerk 0.23.0
item.description:
Minor Changes

  • #23 `0cedc20` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Stellwerk for Mac: a Usage tab beside Setup and Run shows Claude's limits (session, week, week per model) for each Claude account. A second account can be added in Settings → Agents with a token from `claude setup-token`; "Use" switches to it. Optionally, a turn that would draw on extra usage stops and carries on with an account that has room, or just stops. Mac only: the phones don't show limits yet.
  • #23 `0cedc20` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Stellwerk for Mac: Install from source (Settings → Advanced). A row at the bottom of the sidebar builds Stellwerk from its project on this Mac, the default branch or a workspace, and installs it with a restart. Release updates keep coming: the next release replaces the build.
  • #23 `0cedc20` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Experimental token hints (Mac: Settings → Experimental, on every device): in a big Claude chat, the message box suggests /compact after a long pause, when the cached context has expired, and offers to send a message that starts a separate task in a new chat (Haiku on the Mac judges while you type). Mac, iPhone/iPad and Android.

    • Patch Changes

  • #30 `69ce46e` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Android: leaving a screen always ends its live feed; before, it could stay open in the background when the screen closed right after connecting.
  • #23 `0cedc20` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Mac: the Team chats block under each project is gone; a people button next to the project's "+" opens Search on that project's teammates' sessions (People: Teammates). Search's filter shows "Team · Teammates" when People is set, and a project without rows yet shows its name instead of its id.
  • #23 `0cedc20` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Stellwerk for Mac: a downloaded update shows at the bottom of the sidebar ("Update available"), with "Install now" under the pointer. While agents are working it asks first, since the restart ends them.
  • #23 `0cedc20` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Team: a session continued in a new workspace brings its chat along; the new chat showed nothing before (the agent knew the history, you didn't). Prompts from Conductor with attached files no longer show its instructions at the start.

item.title: Stellwerk 0.22.1
item.description:
Patch Changes

  • #25 `18fa5eb` Thanks @fabifink! - Stellwerk for Mac: Claude chats can use Claude in Chrome again, as they could in Conductor. Settings → Agents → Claude in Chrome turns it on (on by default when the Claude extension is installed in Chrome or another Chromium browser), and the row says whether the extension was found. Chats that are running switch after their turn and keep their history. With it off, Claude tells you where to turn it on instead of quietly having no browser tools.

item.title: Stellwerk 0.22.0
item.description:
Minor Changes

  • #22 `35a19d2` Thanks @fabifink! - Operator: the to-do list is the main screen now, on the Mac, iPhone, iPad and Android. Every to-do is one card that keeps its place through all its phases: a short title with the phase and a progress bar, where it stands in one line, the next step, and details folded away. An agent's question and the Operator's decisions show on the card as buttons (the recommended one starred) with an answer field, a ready PR gets a Merge button, and chips filter what needs you, what's to merge, what runs and what's put off (Later). The Operator's chat moved into a bar at the bottom (on the phones the second tab, after To-dos). The Operator writes the cards itself, nudges stuck workspaces, has clear review comments worked off, waits for checks and closes workspaces after a merge; merging and product decisions stay with you.
